name: field
title: Field
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Field family (Field, FieldLabel, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldSet, FieldLegend, FieldGroup, FieldSeparator). Labels in lettering, descriptions in ink, errors in the accent with a "!" mark and a shake. A choice card (FieldLabel wrapping a Field) is a 2px case; checked, it gets a 6px ink bar at the start.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/field". It wraps your own components/ui/field, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: Labels, help text and errors with a “!” mark.
meta.usage:
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/manga/field"

<Field>
  <FieldLabel htmlFor="email">Email</FieldLabel>
  <Input id="email" aria-invalid />
  <FieldError>Add the end of your address.</FieldError>
</Field>
